## T-Mobile grabs for Bluewater's 600MHz licenses, keeping them out of SpaceX's reach

T-Mobile informed the FCC it is acquiring Bluewater Wireless' 600MHz spectrum licenses covering 435 counties in 27 states. It will add about 10MHz of capacity in most areas, and it keeps the spectrum out of the hands of SpaceX.
